artboards.title: Tonight, with the shelf under it

annotations.text:
THE RADICAL MOVE

Stock stops being a tab. Tonight is the front door and the shelf lives underneath it, so four tabs become three.

Your design brief asked for this in September and only half happened: the suggestion came off the stock page, but the stock page never became the stock.

THIS IS YOUR ACTUAL KITCHEN

Every shape and level here comes out of lib/vessel.ts run over the real 47 rows — not drawn by hand.

Only 13 of 47 have a level. The spice rack is entirely hollow, and 19 things have no shelf at all. Both get a row and a way to fix it, because an outline is the only thing here that asks to be filled in.

WHY VESSELS

You already store pack_size, sealed_count and the open amount. A carton drawn 79% full is not decoration — it is data you already have, finally legible.

The shape is derived from the name and the unit. Nothing in the database says 'jar'.

THE HONEST ALTERNATIVE

Keeps the list, adds a kind glyph and a fill bar to every row.

Better: scannable at 47 items, sorts and filters, no horizontal scrolling.
Worse: no whimsy at all, and a bar chart of your kitchen is not a picture of it.
